name: maestro
description: Master orchestrator for Claude Code — classifies tasks, fetches live docs via Context7, generates non-template, anti-default design mockups before frontend implementation (Step 5 with explicit anti-template ban and required-qualities check), enforces layered security (OWASP checklists + real-time edit scanning + SkillSpector supply-chain skill-vetting at Step 8.5), visual verification via Playwright, deep PR review with specialist agents, surfaces cross-session context via claude-mem observations, routes work to domain skill packs via the Skill Pack Registry (engineering, documents, brand, marketing, social media, finance, small business, legal), selects the model per task via Model Routing (Fable for judgement-heavy steps, Opus for execution), composes with an extended plugin ecosystem (UI UX Pro Max, frontend-design, Taste, Transitions, n8n-MCP, VoiceMode, Everything Claude Code, LightRAG), and orchestrates superpowers skills in the correct order, applies a YAGNI-first decision ladder at Step 7 (minimum code that works, gates never relaxed), and reports through a Progress Protocol (flow position first, at most one open ask, evidence above justification, no wall-clock estimates).
